original.target_description: Study 1: looking duration to belief-congruent versus incongruent windows in 25-month-olds, pooled across FB1 and FB2; location main effect in repeated-measures ANOVA, with condition between subjects.

n.sample_role: Children in the retained analytic sample, ten assigned to each false-belief condition; within-subject window-location ANOVA.
n.exclusions: 16 additional children excluded: 11 failed inclusion criterion, 2 looked away at crucial test moment, 2 did not look at either door, 1 could not be calibrated. Inclusion required correct anticipation in the second familiarization trial.
n.location: Accepted manuscript p. 4 (cached PDF p. 5), Participants; ANOVA denominator df = 18 on manuscript p. 7
n.quote: Twenty two-year-olds participated in the experiment

es.location: Accepted manuscript p. 7 (cached PDF p. 8), Results; Participants on manuscript p. 4 (cached PDF p. 5)

p.location: Accepted manuscript p. 7 (cached PDF p. 8), Results; Participants on manuscript p. 4 (cached PDF p. 5)

replication.target_description: The supplied replication paper is available and title-verified. It tests children aged 4.5–5.5 years, not two-year-old infants. Southgate/Senju results contain separate FB1 and FB2 DLS tests (journal p. 7), first-saccade tests and comparisons with prior unnarrated data (p. 8). Locator p. 11 is Discussion in the acquired journal version and does not identify a particular test or condition.

n.location: Journal pp. 3, 6–8 and 11 (cached PDF pp. 4, 7–9 and 12)

es.location: Journal pp. 3, 6–8 and 11 (cached PDF pp. 4, 7–9 and 12)

p.location: Journal pp. 3, 6–8 and 11 (cached PDF pp. 4, 7–9 and 12)

reported_success.location: Journal p. 10 (cached PDF p. 11), Discussion, paragraph beginning In summary
reported_success.quote: only the FB1 condition of the Southgate/Senju task could be replicated.

notes: Original title/DOI verified against cached paper. Requested partial eta squared identifies the pooled location ANOVA; effect size and p are from the same test. Original supplied p.4 is version-dependent: the acquired accepted manuscript has Participants on p.4 and the ANOVA on p.7. Replication supplied p.11 does not uniquely select FB1 versus FB2 or first-saccade versus DLS tests. No single replication n/effect/p was selected arbitrarily, and no pooled d or p was calculated. Replication task-wide retained n is not substituted for an unidentified test analytic sample. Replication author verdict is task-level and explicitly partial; it does not identify a specific numeric target.
